dedupe_keys.name: 2006 commercial vehicle survey origin and destination

description: The Ontario Ministry of Transportation provides origin-destination observations for medium and heavy trucks from its 2006 Commercial Vehicle Survey. Fields identify origin and destination zones,32 commodity groups plus empty trucks, average daily trips, commodity weight in kilograms and commodity value in dollars. Zones aggregate Ontario counties and other Canadian provinces or US states. The survey targets provincial facilities, so intra-urban movements are incomplete and Greater Toronto Area trip activity is not representative. The source reports an average trip distance of 440 km and warns about short-distance interpretation. Pairs with fewer than one average trip per day are suppressed. The provider lists English and French CSV distributions under the Open Government Licence–Ontario. Costs and actual download restrictions were not tested. These demand observations provide inputs to freight and road-network flow models. Related station-count and assigned-road-flow resources use the same survey, but their records do not contain this county/province/state OD commodity table. No data files or row values were fetched.
